reasoning: The claim mischaracterizes the findings of a widely cited March 2023 study by Goldman Sachs. The report did not state that generative AI "will replace" 300 million jobs. Rather, it estimated that generative AI *could expose* the equivalent of 300 million full-time jobs globally to automation. "Exposure to automation" means that certain tasks within a job could be automated, but it does not equate to outright job elimination; in fact, the report notes that most jobs and industries are only partially exposed to automation and are more likely to be complemented rather than substituted by AI. Furthermore, presenting a projection as an absolute certainty ("will") ignores the economic nuances of job creation and productivity boosts that typically accompany technological shifts.
title: Generative AI will replace 300 million jobs
